statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ remains weekend-closed, so current Tail is low while verified Gulf energy-route disruption keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Tail remains below the block threshold. The Sunday Globex reopen is the next price-path checkpoint for gap persistence, retracement depth and cross-asset alignment.
headline: Gulf supply shock concentrates risk at Sunday NQ reopening
body: NQ is closed for the weekend, leaving no live Nasdaq price-path evidence of persistent one-way structure. The Saudi East-West pipeline outage, a Hormuz vessel attack and regional equity weakness intensify energy, inflation and rate stress; actual Tail evidence depends on post-reopen extension and retracement behavior.

lookbackSummary: All 24 preceding UTC clock hours have published ChatGPT assessments. Tail stayed 19%; Stress was 99% through 02:00 UTC and 100% from 03:00 UTC onward, while Confidence stayed 98% and dominantMode remained normal.
outlookSummary: Risk is concentrated at the 22:00 UTC Globex reopening and first post-open hours. A gap that develops two-way trade or meaningful retracements supports low Tail; repeated extension, shallow pullbacks and aligned oil, yields and volatility would justify higher Tail.

forecast.analysis: During the first full post-open hour, WATCH persists conditionally. Meaningful retracements or two-way trade would argue against a pathological one-way path; repeated extension would argue the opposite.

forecast.analysis: In the second full post-open hour, Tail remains WATCH only if early dislocation still lacks meaningful retracement. Two-way trade and fading cross-asset stress would support a lower Tail path.
By this hour, conditional Tail eases if the opening move has produced genuine counter-moves and no repeated extension. Continued one-way efficiency would invalidate that easing assumption.
Conditional Tail returns to low if early price discovery has become two-sided with meaningful retracements. Persistent session-extreme holding or renewed extension would keep risk above this path.
If the post-open market has stabilized, the overnight structure should become more informative than the initial gap. Fresh extension without retracement would be the principal invalidation.

The base path assumes the first reopening shock is being absorbed rather than compounded. Tail would rise only if directional efficiency persists across multiple hours or a new catalyst reinforces it.
Approaching the European morning, low Tail assumes no renewed one-way impulse. A fresh energy headline paired with NQ extension and weak retracements would challenge that assumption.
At the early European transition, conditional Tail stays low if cross-asset moves are mixed or stabilizing. Aligned pressure in NQ, yields, oil and volatility would be the escalation signal.

During the European morning, the forecast assumes no persistent directional reinforcement. Breadth proxies and semiconductor tone can confirm or conflict, but they do not replace live NQ path evidence.
As Europe matures, low Tail depends on NQ continuing to allow meaningful counter-moves. A renewed hold near session extremes with repeated failed retracements would raise path risk.
The midday European hour remains a conditional low-Tail regime absent renewed directional efficiency. Energy and rates remain important transmission channels ahead of U.S. participation.
Entering the U.S. premarket window, low Tail assumes overnight structure remains two-sided. A fresh gap extension with aligned megacap and semiconductor weakness would challenge that view.
One hour before the U.S. cash-open window begins, the forecast keeps Tail low unless premarket structure becomes persistently one-way with shallow pullbacks and cross-asset confirmation.
drivers: One hour to U.S. cash-open window

forecast.analysis: The 13:00 UTC hour contains the 13:30 UTC U.S. cash open. Tail stays low by default; opening-auction continuation, repeated extension and shallow pullbacks would be the relevant escalation evidence.

news.title: S&P 500 ends higher as strong inflation data cements rate-hike bets

forecast.analysis: In the first full cash-session hour, the key question is whether any opening impulse retraces materially. Two-way discovery supports low Tail; failed retracements with broad confirmation would raise it.
After the first cash-session hour, low Tail assumes opening dislocation has not become sustained directional efficiency. Repeated extension from failed pullbacks would invalidate that path.
By mid-session, the forecast assumes price discovery is sufficiently two-sided to keep Tail low. A new geopolitical or energy shock would matter most if it also produces persistent NQ extension.
The later U.S. session remains low Tail conditionally if retracements persist and cross-assets stabilize. A renewed extreme-hold pattern would be a stronger signal than headline importance alone.

Into the final forecast hour, low Tail assumes no fresh one-way structure has emerged. Persistent extension, shallow pullbacks and aligned cross-assets would be required to move materially above this path.

forecastDetail.comment: Current NQ price-path evidence is unavailable because the market is closed; verified Gulf energy disruption raises Stress without confirming persistent mean-reversion failure.
Before the reopen, gap persistence and retracement quality remain unobservable, so the conditional path keeps Tail low absent a new catalyst.
Two hours before reopening, a future gap alone is insufficient Tail evidence; shallow pullbacks or repeated extension would matter more.
One hour before reopening, gap size, first retracement depth and oil/yield/volatility alignment are the principal conditional checkpoints.
At the scheduled reopen, Tail reaches WATCH conditionally because actual gap persistence and retracement behavior become observable.
In the first full post-open hour, WATCH persists only conditionally; meaningful retracements would argue against persistent one-way structure.
